summary: AIR Global PLC filed a Form 6-K furnishing an investor presentation referencing a proposed business combination with Cantor Equity Partners III, Inc. (CAEP), a SPAC. The presentation includes forward-looking statements and disclaimers but does not disclose deal terms, valuation, or advisor names. As a foreign private issuer, AIR uses Form 6-K to communicate material information. The filing is preliminary, with no board recommendation or mechanics detailed. Watch for a definitive proxy statement/prospectus with merger terms, shareholder votes, and regulatory timeline; risk-arb angle centers on SPAC deal completion and redemptions.
